resultJson.title: Add foldLeft sample in new foldleft package
resultJson.body:
Adds `src/main/scala/foldleft/FoldLeft.scala`, a small sample of `foldLeft` in Scala 3. It has `sum`, `lengthHistogram` (the accumulator is a `Map`, not the element type), and a generic `reverse`. A `foldLeftDemo` `@main` prints the results, including a nested-string fold that shows left-to-right order.

The diff also adds `.orca/runs/7d021573fea0.progress.json`, an orca run progress log, not part of the sample.
